item.title: TurboQuant: Redefining AI efficiency with extreme compression
item.description:
📝 Vector quantization is a powerful, classical data compression technique that reduces the size of high-dimensional vectors. Today, we introduce TurboQuant (to be presented at ICLR 2026), a compression algorithm that optimally addresses the challenge of memory overhead in vector quantization. This algorithm essentially creates a high-speed shorthand that requires zero memory overhead.
🔗 Read more: https://research.google/blog/turboquant-redefining-ai-efficiency-with-extreme-compression/
